# golden

Golden vectors (engine-spec 9). `decide/` is filled (see its README); `frame_scale_table.json` and
`sincos_table.json` belong to the geo stage; `geo path detect h3 trig` hold their READMEs until their
vectors land. `MANIFEST.json` lists `{path, sha256}` of every JSON file here and is written by the
`gen_golden` example of `proxim-decide` (`PROXIM_BLESS=1`). See ../README.md.
